arabic text: AB GHAR KO CHALO KHAAK SE UTHTHO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: RISE UP FROM THE SAND ALI AKBAR, LET’S GO HOME

arabic text: PONHCHE JO HUSEIN IBNE ALI LAASHE PISAR PAR\nWO HAAL NAZAR AAYAA CHHURI CHAL GAYI DIL PAR
english translation text: WHEN HUSSAIN-IBNE-ALI ARRIVED AT THE BODY OF HIS SON\nTHE SIGHT OF HIS STATE WAS A KNIFE TO HIS HEART

arabic text: YEH KEHKE ZAMIN PAR GIR-E BETE KE BARAABAR\nAAYAA HAI PIDAR HOSH MEN AAWO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: SAYING THIS, HE FELL TO THE GROUND BESIDE HIS SON\nYOUR FATHER HAS COME, WAKE UP ALI AKBAR

arabic text: ZAALIM KOI BEKAS KO BATAA TAA NA THAA RASTAA\nCHHAAYAA THAA NIGAAHO MEN ANDHERAA HI ANDHERAA
english translation text: THE ENEMIES WOULD NOT SHOW ME THE WAY TO YOU\nMY VISION HAS BEEN OVERCOME BY DARKNESS UPON DARKNESS

arabic text: AAYAA HAI PIDAR PAAS TERE THONKARE KHAATAA\nAANKHON KO HUWAA KYAA MERI PUCHHO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: YOUR FATHER HAS COME TO YOU AFTER MANY STRUGGLES\nASK ME WHAT HAS HAPPENED TO MY EYES ALI AKBAR

arabic text: KYUN PAAUN RAGADTE HO KAHAAN DARD UTHAA HAI\nBATLAAO MERI JAAN MERAA DIL BAITH RAHAA HAI.
english translation text: WHY ARE YOU THRASHING YOUR FEET, WHERE DOES IT HURT?\nSHOW ME MY LOVE, MY HEART IS SINKING

arabic text: KYUN HAATH HAI SIN-E PE KAHAAN ZAKHM LAGAA HAI\nPHAT JAAEGAA DIL BAAP KAA BOLO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: WHY IS YOUR HAND ON YOUR CHEST, WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN WOUNDED?\nMY HEART WILL BURST, TELL YOUR FATHER ALI AKBAR

arabic text: AI LAAL TASAWWUR MEN THAA MAAKE TERAA SEHRAA\nHAI DER SE DARWAAZA-E KHAIMAA PE WOH DUKHIYAA
english translation text: OH MY SON, YOUR MOTHER’S THOUGHTS WERE OF YOUR WEDDING\nFOR A LONG TIME SHE HAS BEEN STANDING AT THE DOOR OF THE TENT

arabic text: KYAA JAAKE BATAAUN JO HUWAA HAAL TUMHAARAA\nLAILAA SE KAHUN KYAA YEH BATAAO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: WHAT WILL I GO BACK AND TELL HER ABOUT YOUR STATE\nTELL ME THIS ALI AKBAR, WHAT WILL I TELL LAYLA?

arabic text: NAWHA HAI LABO PAR HAIU LAHU AANKHON SE JAARI\nHAM KAB SE KHADE ROTE HAI BAALI PE TUMHAARI
english translation text: WITH LAMENTATION ON THE LIPS; (TEARS OF) BLOOD FLOWS FROM THE EYES\nFOR HOW LONG HAVE WE BEEN STANDING HERE, CRYING BY YOUR SIDE?

arabic text: KHAAYAA NA TARAS TUMNE GHARIBI PE HAMAARI\nDIL BAAP KA IS TARHAA NA TODO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: DO YOU HAVE NO PITY ON OUR LONELINESS?\nDO NOT BREAK YOUR FATHER'S HEART, ALI AKBAR

arabic text: AB DER JO KI TUMNE TO KARTI HUWI ZAARI\nBE PARDAA BAHAN AAEGI MAQTAL MEN HAMAARI
english translation text: NOW THAT YOU’VE DELAYED RETURNING, SHE IS LAMENTING\nWITHOUT HER VEIL, MY SISTER WILL COME TO THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: MAADAR KAHIN MARJAAE NA SADMENSE TUMHAARI\nBAABAA BHI NAHIN JINE-KE SUNLO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: MAY YOUR MOTHER NOT DIE FROM THIS HEARTACHE\nYOUR FATHER ALSO WILL NOT SURVIVE THIS, LISTEN ALI AKBAR

arabic text: KIS TARHA SE DEKHE YE PIDAR HAAL TUMHAARAA\nQABU ME NAHI QALB ULAJTAA HAI KALEJA
english translation text: O! HOW CAN YOUR FATHER BEAR TO SEE YOUR STATE?\nMY HEART IS UNCONTROLLED, FRAYED!

arabic text: PEHLU ME HAI DIL BAAP KAA PATHTHAR NAHI BETAA\nAAGE MERE IS TARHA NA TADPO ALI AKBAR
english translation text: THIS CHEST HAS A FATHER'S HEART, NOT A STONE, MY SON!\nDO NOT THUS WRITHE IN PAIN BEFORE ME ALI AKBAR!
